romania.title: Flag of Romania
desc: - Three equal vertical stripes of blue, yellow, and red, adopted after the 1989 Romanian Revolution
- The tricolour design represents truth, generosity, and bravery
trivia:
- The colours are identical to Chad's flag, occasionally causing diplomatic confusion
- The coat of arms features the eagle with a cross, representing sovereignty and Christian faith
- Romania adopted this tricolour in 1848 during the Revolutions of 1848
